handbook.what: Setting up a class of your own: a name, a language, and a link students use to join it. A class holds a roster, its own place on the course, and everything the class practises together.
handbook.where: **My Classes**, the **+ New class** button along the top of the page.
how: Give the class a name you will recognise on a list, such as Year 7 Welsh.
Choose the language the class is learning.
handbook.note: The join link is made for you at the same moment. Nothing else is needed to start teaching.
